final: WITH color_counts AS (SELECT p.product_color, COUNT(*) AS color_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), totals AS (SELECT SUM(color_count) AS total_count FROM color_counts), combined AS (SELECT c.color_count, 1.0 * c.color_count / t.total_count AS proportion FROM color_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(color_count) AS average_count FROM combined) SELECT AVG(c.color_count), AVG(c.proportion), AVG(c.color_count - a.average_count) FROM combined AS c CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE a.average_count IS NOT NULL AND c.color_count > a.average_count
